name: Li Andersson - Annexe I, § 1 - Am 39
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on guidelines for the employment policies of the Member States
part_text: Member States should promote a sustainable and highly competitive market economy. They should facilitate investment, innovation and productivity growth to support quality job creation, particularly in strategic sectors. They should reduce unnecessary administrative burdens on businesses, especially SMEs, while respecting workers' rights and fostering entrepreneurship. Member States should make greater use of public procurement and industrial investment policies to support European production and employment, including through European preference criteria in strategic public procurement, in accordance with applicable law, in order to strengthen industrial sovereignty and preserve skilled jobs in Europe.
